description: This file defines a configuration and transformation utilities for Jina AI embeddings within a larger machine learning or AI project. It includes classes and methods for handling API interactions, request/response transformation, environment validation, and configuration management specifically for Jina AI's embedding service.

classes.name: JinaAIEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class tailored for Jina AI's embedding API, including settings management, URL construction, request/response transformation, and environment validation.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of class-level configuration parameters excluding methods and special attributes.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-style parameters, specifically 'dimensions'.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default OpenAI parameters into optional parameters, specifically handling 'dimensions'.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Provides provider info including API base URL and API key, integrating secret management.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for embedding requests based on provided base URL and defaults.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: AllEmbeddingInputValues, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input data into the format expected by Jina AI's embedding API, handling base64-encoded images and text.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: EmbeddingResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str], request_data: dict, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Processes raw API responses, logging call details, and returning structured embeddings.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Prepares and validates request headers, including authorization tokens.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns a custom exception class for handling Jina AI errors.
